name: @w6w-apps/sendy
description: Manage subscribers and send campaigns on a self-hosted Sendy newsletter installation.

w6w.longDescription:
Sendy is self-hosted newsletter software that sends through your own Amazon SES account. It has no vendor host of its own — every workflow talks to the operator's own installation — so this app covers Sendy's documented HTTP API exactly as published at sendy.co/api: adding, removing and deleting subscribers, reading a subscriber's status and a list's active count, listing lists and brands, and creating (optionally sending or scheduling) a campaign.

Because Sendy ships as software you run yourself, there is no vendor status to watch — the API's own error text is the only signal a workflow gets, and this app reads it literally rather than guessing from an HTTP status code.
